why: Intro to Docker plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-docker.json), 'Run your first container' (passes: docker ps -a lists a hello-world container that exited with code 0). The first `docker run hello-world` failed because Docker Desktop was not running yet ('Cannot connect to the Docker daemon'). The learner opened Docker and ran it again: the image pulled and 'Hello from Docker!' printed, exit 0. The daemon error is from before the run that worked. Done.

step.title: Run hello-world
step.instructions: Open Docker Desktop and wait until it says Engine running. Then run docker run hello-world in the terminal and read what it prints.
